# Load necessary library

library(ggplot2)

# Set seed for reproducibility

set.seed(3)

# Roll a 6-sided die 10000 times

die \<- floor(runif(10000, 1, 7)) \# Corrected the upper limit to 7

# Create histogram

ggplot(data = data.frame(die), aes(x = die, limits = c(1, 6))) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", color = "black") + labs(title = "Random Coin Flips (10000 Obs)", x = "Outcome", y = "Percentage")

# Set seed for a different result

set.seed(7)

# Roll a second 6-sided die 10000 times

die_2 \<- floor(runif(10000, 1, 7)) \# Corrected the upper limit to 7

# Add the results of two dice rolls

dice \<- die + die_2

# Create histogram

ggplot(data = data.frame(dice), aes(x = dice, limits = c(2, 12))) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "green", color = "black") + labs(title = "Random Dice Rolls (10000 Obs)", x = "Sum of Two Dice", y = "Percentage")
